name: Approach Pavilion
summary: An oblique barrel-vault mosque opens onto a path that continues directly from its doorway.
why: The visible side wall gives the mark depth. Both doorway jambs continue into the path, and the roof edge and side-wall edge use the same thirteen-unit depth offset.
risk: At 24px the perspective is more pictorial than the simpler marks, and the entrance reads as a single opening.
key1: A path begins at the door
sub1: Both jambs become the approach edges
sub2: A broad vault and square minaret create depth
reasonToChoose: An oblique barrel-vault mosque opens onto a path that continues directly from its doorway.
